verdict.rationale: LightSprint's engineering panel claims to analyze codebase reliability, security and velocity and to surface recommendations you can turn into tasks. A Merge Readiness score and plain-English change summaries add some insight-style output. The evidence is limited to brief marketing lines and never explicitly says the recommendations are AI-generated. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights and recommendations are produced and from which data, explicit AI-generation of the recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Analyze codebase reliability and security while measuring velocity. Get recommendations and start tasks from one panel.
they see a plain-English summary plus the actual diff first.
